Job Description

Position Overview

We are seeking a driven, proactive, and detail-oriented Warranty & Repair Co-Op to join our Service Operations team. In this hands-on role, you will bridge the gap between enterprise systems and hands-on shop floor execution. You will support continuous improvement projects across SAP system modeling, technical training frameworks, digital quality systems (SOCOS), and lean 5S shop floor layout re-engineering.

This position offers extensive exposure to engineering principles, ERP system workflows, operational excellence, and Quality Systems compliance.

Key Responsibilities & Potential Projects

1. SAP Operations & Quoting Optimization

- Time Reclassification: Audit and update labor activity types to ensure accurate cost allocation and booking integrity.

- Planned vs. Actual Alignment: Conduct time studies and historical variance analyses across four critical repair stages—Inspection, Repair, Testing, and Final Inspection—calibrating SAP master routings to real-world performance.

- Quoting Procedure Development: Build upon and improve the current repair quotation process; develop improved and streamlined quotation tools and practices.

2. Technical Training & Skills Architecture

- Skills Categorization: Inventory technician competencies, mapping hands-on capabilities against specific material groups and diagnostic equipment.

- Competency Matrix Expansion: Develop modular training plans and expand the operational skill matrix by integrating online training modules, Fit for Service curricula, and in-house workshops.

- Standardized Inspection Documentation: Translate tacit diagnostic knowledge into clear, structured, and visually guided inspection reference guides.

3. File Architecture & Warranty Governance

- Shared File Folder Restructuring: Review and restructure the legacy network file repository to make file searches and saving more intuitive and efficient.

- Document Lifecycle Management: Identify, log, and safely archive obsolete documents, spreadsheets, and superseded working aids.

- Warranty Document Review: Conduct a comprehensive audit of existing Warranty Agreements, ensuring only active, validated, and current legal revisions are retained.

4. Work Instructions & SOCOS Documentation

- Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Review existing Service Work Instructions (WIs) across all technical repair workstations.

- Document Harmonization: Update or archive legacy Work Instructions.

- Regulatory & System Release: Route revised documentation through formal review and release workflows within SOCOS, ensuring full compliance.

5. Shop Floor Lean Layout & 5S Implementation

- Layout & Flow Optimization: Map the physical service area layout using value stream mapping and spaghetti diagrams to minimize material handling waste and technician travel time.

- Point-of-Use Storage: Establish structured inventory storage (kanban) quantities and ordering processes for hardware and consumables (cover plates, bolts, protective caps, overstock).

- 5S Staging Lane Execution: Standardize floor markings, visual controls, and operational rules across designated staging lanes and areas such as:

- Incoming

- Return to Stock

- Return to Customer

- Quality Holds

- Internal service order (YINT) Inspection

- Office & Cabinet Realignment: Lead 5S sorting and purging of physical material cabinets, securely archiving critical records and systematically disposing of redundant or obsolete documents.

Qualifications

Academic Standing: Must be enrolled in an accredited undergraduate or graduate degree program

Preferred Majors: Mechanical or Industrial Engineering.

- Other technical disciplines would be considered, based on additional skills/qualifications and prior work experience.

Analytical Skills: Strong analytical aptitude with proficiency in data manipulation and modeling using Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookup formulas, data validation).

Communication & Organization: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to interface comfortably between shop floor technicians, specialists, and management.

Problem-Solving & Initiative: Self-starter mindset with demonstrated interest in continuous improvement (Kaizen, Lean, 5S).

Preferred / Nice-to-Have:

- Familiarity or prior coursework in SAP ERP (Production Planning, Plant Maintenance, or Customer Service modules).

The role

You will support product bring-up and validation across lab hardware and software, help automate repeatable workflows, and collaborate with engineers across hardware, validation, firmware, and manufacturing.

This internship is an opportunity to build practical experience at the hardware/software boundary while contributing to connectivity products used in demanding AI, cloud, server, and networking environments.

- Support PCBA bring-up, including board programming, debugging, and board-level troubleshooting.

- Develop or extend scripts and software—especially in Python, with C/C++ or Java also relevant—to automate instrument control, testing, and data collection.

- Execute structured validation and characterization activities, document observations and defects, and communicate findings clearly.

- Help maintain accurate lab documentation, test instructions, build information, and issue-tracking records.

- Work with multidisciplinary engineering teams to diagnose problems, close action items, and improve lab and product workflows.

- Learn and apply concepts related to signal integrity, S-parameters, SERDES, jitter, PCIe®, and other high-speed serial interfaces.

What you bring

Basic qualifications

- Currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.

- Strong foundation in analog and digital circuit fundamentals.

- Coursework, project, research, or hands-on experience with electronics, hardware systems, or software-controlled test equipment.

- Familiarity with laboratory equipment and a methodical approach to measurement and troubleshooting.

- Strong scripting or software-development experience in Python or another programming language.

- Strong written and verbal communication, organization, and time-management skills.

- A hands-on work ethic, curiosity, and ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-moving environment.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Python to automate or control lab instruments.

- Experience with microcontrollers, Arduino or Raspberry Pi projects, custom PCs, or similar hardware/software systems.

- Experience with printed-circuit-board assembly, PCBA bring-up, board programming, or electronics debugging.

- Familiarity with Cadence Allegro or comparable electronics design tools.

- Knowledge of signal integrity, S-parameters, SERDES architecture, or jitter decomposition.

- Exposure to PCI Express (PCIe®), USB, or other high-speed serial interfaces.

- Co-align the beacon laser with the observational telescope and verify boresight

- Design a repeatable field alignment procedure that corrects misalignment introduced during transport and installation at the DoW site

- Write that procedure so a non-optics operator can execute it, then validate it hands-on before delivery

- Maintain clean alignment and characterization records, and feed findings back to the engineering team

- Experience writing test or alignment procedures that other people have actually followed

- Demonstrated interest in defense, space, or energy applications
